Using his expertise with [[exo-technology]] and working in conjunction with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Syo Bakarn]], the scientist [[Tharan Cedrax]] developed a '''device''' in [[3643 BBY]] that could prevent a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from [[Mind trick/Legends|affecting]] a person's mind with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The device worked by paralyzing the part of the forebrain that became active when a Jedi tried to exert his influence upon their target.
